verdict.rationale: Mercury shows some AI-driven data processing (bill-reading AI populating details, AI-powered automations for bookkeeping) and MCP-based natural-language querying of balances/transactions, plus agent skills like mercury-analyze-spend and mercury-detect-anomaly for anomaly detection. However, these are largely retrieval/automation features rather than proactive, in-product 'insights and suggestions' generated from a user's data (e.g., no evidence of spend trend analysis, forecasting, or recommendation surfaces inside the main product UI). missing for 10: in-product proactive insights/dashboards synthesizing user financial data, evidence of suggestion-generation beyond anomaly-detection skill, and independent/hands-on confirmation these AI features work as described.
